name: Create
description: A design canvas: Ava builds pages as HTML and CSS artboards while you watch.

tools.name: list_artboards
tools.description: List the artboards on the person's Create board (their design canvas): each one's id, name, position and size, and the board's style (css or tailwind). Start here before changing a design.

tools.name: new_artboard
tools.description: Add an artboard to the Create board: one page or screen of a design, drawn from HTML and CSS. Give it a name and, ideally, its whole page in `html` straight away (a <style> block plus the page's elements; use the board's tokens as var(--color-accent) etc.; no scripts; images only as inline <svg> or data: URLs). In a tailwind board, style with Tailwind classes instead. Desktop pages are 1440 wide, phones 390. It appears on the canvas at once.

html.description: The page: HTML with a <style> block, or a whole HTML document.

height.description: Height in pixels (default 1024). Make it tall enough for the whole page.

x.description: Where on the canvas (default: right of the others).

y.description: Where on the canvas (default: level with the others).

tools.name: read_artboard
tools.description: Read one artboard's HTML from the Create board, by its id or name.

tools.name: write_artboard
tools.description: Replace an artboard's whole HTML on the Create board (a <style> block plus the page's elements, or a whole document). For a small change use patch_artboard instead.

tools.name: patch_artboard
tools.description: Change part of an artboard on the Create board: every element matching a CSS selector. Actions: set_text (new words, in `text`), set_html (new inside, in `html`), replace (the element itself, `html`), append / prepend (inside it, `html`), insert_before / insert_after (next to it, `html`), remove, set_style (CSS declarations in `style`, e.g. 'color: #333; padding: 24px'), set_attribute / remove_attribute (`attribute`, `value`), add_class / remove_class (`value`). If nothing matches, the error lists selectors that exist.

selector.description: A CSS selector, e.g. '#hero h1' or '.card'.

tools.name: move_artboard
tools.description: Rename, move or resize an artboard on the Create board. Give only what changes.

tools.name: delete_artboard
tools.description: Delete an artboard from the Create board.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: The Create board's design tokens: CSS variables (colours, fonts, radius…) every artboard can use as var(--name).

tools.name: set_tokens
tools.description: Set design tokens on the Create board, e.g. { "--color-accent": "#e4572e", "--font-sans": "Georgia, serif" }. Every artboard that uses them changes at once. An empty value removes one.

tools.name: look_at_artboard
tools.description: Look at an artboard on the Create board as it's drawn: a picture of it, and its layout (the main pieces with their positions and words, and problems such as content cut off at the bottom or images that don't load). Use it to check your work.

tools.name: set_board_style
tools.description: Switch how the Create board's artboards are styled: 'css' (their own <style> blocks) or 'tailwind' (Tailwind classes, with the tokens as the theme: --color-accent gives bg-accent, text-accent). Only when the person asks for Tailwind or plain CSS.
